topics.title: Pods, ReplicaSets & Declarative Deployments
topics.objective: Define immutable pod specifications, replica controllers, and rolling update strategies.
topics.exercise: Author a declarative Kubernetes Deployment YAML for a stateless web application with liveness and readiness probes.

topics.title: Service Abstraction, ClusterIP & Ingress Controllers
topics.objective: Route internal cluster traffic with ClusterIP and external ingress with TLS termination.
topics.example: apiVersion: v1 kind: Service metadata: name: backend-svc
topics.exercise: Configure an Ingress resource with path-based routing pointing to two distinct backend microservices.

topics.title: ConfigMaps, Secrets & Environment Injection
topics.objective: Externalize configuration parameters and sensitive credentials securely.
topics.exercise: Create an encrypted Secret YAML for database credentials and mount it as a read-only volume in a container.

topics.title: PersistentVolumes (PV) & PersistentVolumeClaims (PVC)
topics.objective: Provision stateful durable storage across cluster pod restarts.
topics.exercise: Deploy a PostgreSQL stateful instance attached to an automated StorageClass PVC with 10Gi allocation.

topics.title: RBAC Roles, RoleBindings & NetworkPolicies
topics.objective: Isolate tenant workloads with namespace boundaries and restrict inter-pod egress/ingress network flows.
topics.example: kind: NetworkPolicy spec: podSelector: matchLabels: role: db
topics.exercise: Write a NetworkPolicy that only allows ingress traffic on port 5432 from pods with the label role: backend.
